escaped.speaker: narrator
escaped.text: An old Buddhist vihara, half-swallowed by the hill. Gold light pooled on the floor like water.

esc2.speaker: bhikkhu
esc2.text: You ran well. Most of the ones he raises never think to run. Come - sit with me.

saved.speaker: narrator
saved.text: He woke on cool stone. Gold light. Incense. A face - an ordinary, unmasked, smiling face.

sv2.speaker: bhikkhu
sv2.text: Easy. You were very nearly gone. Your light had sunk so low he could reach right in and take it.

sv3.speaker: bhikkhu
sv3.text: We pulled you back through the gutter between pages. It cost us a lamp or two. You were worth it.
